# Fly.io Community

> > Community forum for Fly.io users discussing deployment, troubleshooting, and best practices for hosting applications with technologies like Phoenix, PostgreSQL, and Python.

This is the official community discussion board for Fly.io, a platform-as-a-service provider. Users share deployment experiences, seek technical support, and discuss framework-specific implementations, particularly around Phoenix/Elixir and database configurations.

## Key Topics

- Fly.io platform
- Phoenix framework
- PostgreSQL/Postgres databases
- Deployment strategies
- flyctl CLI tool
- Elixir applications
- Python deployment
- Billing and pricing
- Security configuration
- WireGuard networking
- SSL/TLS setup
- Community support
- LLM hosting
- Database management

## Community Hub

- [Fly.io Community - Latest](https://community.fly.io/latest): Latest discussions on Fly.io community covering support and updates
- [Fly.io Community - Top](https://community.fly.io/top): Community forum homepage featuring top discussions on Fly.io hosting
- [About - Fly.io](https://community.fly.io/about): About page listing Fly.io community admins and moderators
- [FAQ - Fly.io](https://community.fly.io/faq): Community guidelines and forum rules for Fly.io discussion board

## Questions & Troubleshooting

- [Questions / Help - Fly.io](https://community.fly.io/c/questions-and-help/11): Support forum for Fly.io troubleshooting and deployment questions
- [How concerned should I be about a surprise bill?](https://community.fly.io/t/how-concerned-should-i-be-about-a-surprise-bill/5811): Discussion about Fly.io billing concerns and surprise charges on free tier
- [Seeking advice about securing postgres on Fly](https://community.fly.io/t/seeking-advice-about-securing-postgres-on-fly/7861): Help thread on securing PostgreSQL with SSL and WireGuard on Fly.io
